columns.name: RxCui
columns.summary: For NewCrop medical orders, corresponds to the RxCui of the prescription (NewCrop only returns a value sometimes).  Otherwise, this field is synched with the medication.RxCui field based on medication.MedicationNum.  We should have used a string type.  The only purpose of this field is so that when CCDs are created, we have structured data to put in the XML, not just plain text.  Allergies exported in CCD do not look at this table, but only at the medication table.  Medications require MedicationPat.RxCui or Medication.RxCui to be exported on CCD.

columns.name: ErxGuid
columns.summary:
Uniquely identifies the prescription corresponding to the medical order.
            Allows us to update existing eRx medical orders when refreshing prescriptions in the Chart (similar to how prescriptions are updated).
            Also used in 2-way medication synching with eRx.

columns.name: IsCpoe
columns.summary: If eRx is used to prescribe a medication, a medication order is imported automatically into Open Dental.  If a provider is logged in, then this is CPOE (Computerized Provider Order Entry), and this will be true.   Or, if a provider is logged in and Rx entered through OD, it's also CPOE.  If a staff person is logged in, and enters an Rx through NewCrop or OD, then this is non-CPOE, so false.

columns.name: OIDExternalNum
columns.summary: Primary key.

columns.name: IDType
columns.summary: Enum:IdentifierType Internal data type to be associated with.

enumerations.name: IdentifierType
enumerations.summary: Stored as string. Sorted and displayed in the order they are present in this enum.  Root should always be first.

values.name: Root
values.value: Will most likely be the root of all other OIDs.  Represents the organization.

values.name: LabOrder
values.value: FK to ehrlab.EhrLabNum.  root+".1"

values.name: Patient
values.value: FK to patient.PatNum.  root+".2"

values.name: Provider
values.value: FK to provider.ProvNum.  root+".3"

values.name: CqmItem
values.value: This will be the root for all CQM reported items, like encounters, procedures, problems, etc.  root+".4"  The extension will be abbreviated name concatenated with the primary key of the object.  Examples: pat5231 or medpat197432 or proc231782 or notperf38291.  This is only used for generating QRDA documents and requires that the encounter, procedure, etc. is uniquely identified in the reports.  The root+".4" makes it unique to this office, the abbreviated name plus primary key makes it unique within the office.

values.name: Problem
values.value: FK to disease.DiseaseNum.  root+".5"

values.name: Appointment
values.value: FK to appointment.AptNum.  root+".6"

values.name: InsPlan
values.value: FK to insplan.PlanNum.  root+".7"

values.name: Procedure
values.value: FK to procedurelog.ProcNum.  root+".8"

columns.name: IDInternal
columns.summary: This should be a Primary Key to a Table Type defined by the IDType field. Example: If IDType==Patient, then this field should be a PatNum that is a FK to Patient.Patnum

columns.name: IDExternal
columns.summary: The OID extension, when combined with rootExternal it uniquely identifies an object.

columns.name: rootExternal
columns.summary: The OID root, when combined with IDExternal it uniquely identifies an object.

tables.name: operatory
tables.summary: Each row is a single operatory or column in the appts module.

columns.name: OperatoryNum
columns.summary: Primary key

columns.name: OpName
columns.summary: The full name to show in the column.

columns.name: Abbrev
columns.summary: 5 char or less. Not used much.

columns.name: ItemOrder
columns.summary: The order that this op column will show.  Changing views only hides some ops; it does not change their order.  Zero based.

columns.name: IsHidden
columns.summary: Used instead of deleting to hide an op that is no longer used.

columns.name: ProvDentist
columns.summary: FK to provider.ProvNum.  The dentist assigned to this op.  If more than one dentist might be assigned to an op, then create a second op and use one for each dentist. If 0, then no dentist is assigned.

columns.name: ProvHygienist
columns.summary: FK to provider.ProvNum.  The hygienist assigned to this op.  If 0, then no hygienist is assigned.

columns.name: IsHygiene
columns.summary: Set true if this is a hygiene operatory.  The hygienist will then be considered the main provider for this op.

columns.name: ClinicNum
columns.summary: FK to clinic.ClinicNum.  0 if no clinic.

columns.name: DateTStamp
columns.summary: Not user editable. The last time this row was edited.

columns.name: SetProspective
columns.summary: If true patients put into this operatory will have status set to prospective.

columns.name: IsWebSched
columns.summary: Operatories with IsWebSched set to true will be the ONLY operatories considered when searching for available time slots.

columns.name: IsNewPatAppt
columns.summary:
Deprecated as of 18.1.  Entries within the deflink table indicate if this operatory is in fact available for WebSched New Pat Appt.
            Old summary: Operatories with IsNewPatAppt set to true will be the ONLY operatories considered when searching for available time slots.
            This is in regards to the New Patient Appointment portion of the Web Sched web application.

columns.name: OperatoryType
columns.summary: FK to definition.DefNum. The type of the Operatory. This value is not normally used, but rather to just mark which type the Operatory is.

tables.name: orthocharttab
tables.summary: Links one orthocharttab to one displayfield.  Allows for displayfields to be part of multiple orthocharttabs.

columns.name: OrthoChartTabNum
columns.summary: FK to orthocharttab.OrthoChartTabNum.

columns.name: ItemOrder
columns.summary: Overrides the displayfield ItemOrder, so that each display field can have a different order in each ortho chart tab.

tables.name: orthohardwarespec
tables.summary: Specification for ortho hardware. Linked to one type such as bracket, wire, or elastic. This is a pick list of description and color for the user. These remain linked to patient data, so changes here will affect historical chart entries.

columns.name: OrthoHardwareSpecNum
columns.summary: Primary key.

columns.name: OrthoHardwareType
columns.summary: Enum:EnumOrthoHardwareType Bracket, Wire, or Elastic.

columns.name: Description
columns.summary: Example NITI 16x25

columns.name: ItemOrder
columns.summary: 0 indexed. User controls it with arrows.

tables.name: patfield
tables.summary: These are custom fields added and managed by the user. Each row here is a field value for one patient.

columns.name: PatFieldNum
columns.summary: Primary key.

columns.name: PatNum
columns.summary: FK to patient.PatNum

columns.name: FieldName
columns.summary: FK to patfielddef.FieldName.  The full name is shown here for ease of use when running queries.  But the user is only allowed to change fieldNames in the patFieldDef setup window.

columns.name: FieldValue
columns.summary: Any text that the user types in.  For picklists, this will contain the picked text.  For dates, this is stored as the user typed it, after validating that it could be parsed.  So queries that involve dates won't work very well.  If we want better handling of date fields, we should add a column to this table.  Checkbox will either have a value of 1, or else the row will be deleted from the db.  Currency is handled in a culture neutral way, just like other currency in the db.

columns.name: SecUserNumEntry
columns.summary: FK to userod.UserNum.  Set to the user logged in when the row was inserted at SecDateEntry date and time.

columns.name: SecDateEntry
columns.summary: Timestamp automatically generated and user not allowed to change.  The actual date of entry.

columns.name: SecDateTEdit
columns.summary:
Automatically updated by MySQL every time a row is added or changed. Could be changed due to user editing, custom queries or program
            updates.  Not user editable with the UI.

tables.name: patfielddef
tables.summary: These are the definitions for the custom patient fields added and managed by the user.

columns.name: PatFieldDefNum
columns.summary: Primary key.

columns.name: FieldName
columns.summary: This is treated as the key. The name of the field that the user will be allowed to fill in the patient info window.

columns.name: FieldType
columns.summary: Enum:PatFieldType Text=0,PickList=1,Date=2,Checkbox=3,Currency=4

values.name: Date
values.value: 2-Stored in db as entered, already localized.  For example, it could be 2/04/11, 2/4/11, 2/4/2011, or any other variant.  This makes it harder to create queries that filter by date, but easier to display dates as part of results.

values.name: Checkbox
values.value: 3-If checked, value stored as "1".  If unchecked, row deleted.

values.name: Currency
values.value: 4-Numbers only.

values.name: InCaseOfEmergency
values.value: 5 - DEPRECATED. (Only used 16.3.1, deprecated by 16.3.4)

values.name: CareCreditStatus
values.value: 6 - CareCredit pre-approval status. For example, FieldValue string="Pre-Approved", from CareCreditWebStatus enum.

values.name: CareCreditPreApprovalAmt
values.value: 7 - CareCredit pre-approval amount.

values.name: CareCreditAvailableCredit
values.value: 8 - CareCredit - Remaining available Credit for CareCredit cardholders.

columns.name: PickList
columns.summary: Deprecated. Use patfieldpickitem.

columns.name: IsHidden
columns.summary: Hides this PatField for any patient where it's currently blank. If already in use by a patient, then it still shows.

tables.name: patient
tables.summary: One row for each patient.  Includes deleted patients.

columns.name: PatNum
columns.summary: Primary key.

columns.name: LName
columns.summary: Last name.

columns.name: FName
columns.summary: First name.

columns.name: MiddleI
columns.summary: Middle initial or name.

columns.name: Preferred
columns.summary: Preferred name, aka nickname.

columns.name: PatStatus
columns.summary: Enum:PatientStatus

values.name: Archived
values.value: 3 - This status is also used for a merged patient that you're not keeping.

values.name: Prospective
values.value: 6- Not an actual patient yet.

columns.name: Gender
columns.summary: Enum:PatientGender

enumerations.name: PatientGender
enumerations.summary: Known as administrativeGender (HL7 OID of 2.16.840.1.113883.5.1) Male=M, Female=F, Unknown=Undifferentiated=UN.

values.name: Unknown
values.value: 2- Required by HIPAA for privacy.  Required by ehr to track missing entries. EHR/HL7 known as undifferentiated (UN).

columns.name: Position
columns.summary: Enum:PatientPosition Marital status would probably be a better name for this column.

enumerations.name: PatientPosition
enumerations.summary: Single, Married, Child, Widowed, Divorced.

columns.name: Birthdate
columns.summary: Age is not stored in the database.  Age is always calculated as needed from birthdate.

columns.name: SSN
columns.summary: In the US, this is 9 digits, no dashes. For all other countries, any punctuation or format is allowed.

columns.name: Address2
columns.summary: Optional second address line.

columns.name: State
columns.summary: 2 Char in USA.  Used to store province for Canadian users.

columns.name: Zip
columns.summary: Postal code.  For Canadian claims, it must be ANANAN.  No validation gets done except there.

columns.name: HmPhone
columns.summary: Home phone. Includes any punctuation

columns.name: Guarantor
columns.summary: FK to patient.PatNum.  Head of household.

columns.name: CreditType
columns.summary:
Single char. Shows at upper right corner of appointments.  Suggested use is A,B,or C to designate creditworthiness, 
            but it can actually be used for any purpose.

columns.name: Salutation
columns.summary:
Dear __.  This field does not include the "Dear" or a trailing comma.  If this field is blank, then the typical salutation is 
            FName.  Or, if a Preferred name is present, that is used instead of FName.

columns.name: EstBalance
columns.summary: Current patient balance.(not family). Never subtracts insurance estimates.

columns.name: PriProv
columns.summary:
FK to provider.ProvNum.  The patient's primary provider.  Required.  The database maintenance tool ensures that every patient 
            always has this number set, so the program no longer has to handle 0.

columns.name: SecProv
columns.summary: FK to provider.ProvNum.  Secondary provider (hygienist). Optional.

columns.name: FeeSched
columns.summary:
FK to feesched.FeeSchedNum.  Fee schedule for this patient.  Usually not used.  If missing, the practice default fee schedule is 
            used. If patient has insurance, then the fee schedule for the insplan is used.

columns.name: BillingType
columns.summary: FK to definition.DefNum.  Must have a value, or the patient will not show on some reports.

columns.name: ImageFolder
columns.summary: Name of folder where images will be stored. Not editable for now.

columns.name: AddrNote
columns.summary: Address or phone note.  Unlimited length in order to handle data from other programs during a conversion.

columns.name: FamFinUrgNote
columns.summary: Family financial urgent note.  Only stored with guarantor, and shared for family.

columns.name: MedUrgNote
columns.summary: Individual patient note for Urgent medical.

columns.name: ApptModNote
columns.summary: Individual patient note for Appointment module note.

columns.name: StudentStatus
columns.summary: Single char.  Nonstudent='N' or blank, Parttime='P', Fulltime='F'.

columns.name: SchoolName
columns.summary:
College name.  If Canadian, then this is field C10 and must be filled if C9 (patient.CanadianEligibilityCode) is 1 and patient 
            is 18 or older.

columns.name: ChartNumber
columns.summary: Usually blank. Alternative and supplement to PatNum. Can take alphanumeric. Usually set during conversion or when bridging to imaging software. Historically, it typically showed as a sticker on the outside of a paper chart.  Max length 100 to support larger ids for bridging to imaging softwares.

columns.name: MedicaidID
columns.summary: Optional. The Medicaid ID for this patient.

columns.name: Bal_0_30
columns.summary: Aged balance from 0 to 30 days old. Aging numbers are for entire family.  Only stored with guarantor.

columns.name: Bal_31_60
columns.summary: Aged balance from 31 to 60 days old. Aging numbers are for entire family.  Only stored with guarantor.

columns.name: Bal_61_90
columns.summary: Aged balance from 61 to 90 days old. Aging numbers are for entire family.  Only stored with guarantor.

columns.name: BalOver90
columns.summary: Aged balance over 90 days old. Aging numbers are for entire family.  Only stored with guarantor.

columns.name: InsEst
columns.summary: Insurance Estimate for entire family. Only stored with guarantor.

columns.name: BalTotal
columns.summary:
Total balance for entire family before insurance estimate.  Not the same as the sum of the 4 aging balances because this can be 
            negative.  Only stored with guarantor.

columns.name: EmployerNum
columns.summary: FK to employer.EmployerNum.

columns.name: EmploymentNote
columns.summary: Not used since version 2.8.

columns.name: County
columns.summary: FK to county.CountyName, although it will not crash if key absent.

columns.name: GradeLevel
columns.summary: Enum:PatientGrade Gradelevel.

enumerations.name: PatientGrade
enumerations.summary: Grade level used in public health.

columns.name: Urgency
columns.summary: Enum:TreatmentUrgency Used in public health screenings.

enumerations.name: TreatmentUrgency
enumerations.summary: For public health.  Unknown, NoProblems, NeedsCarE, or Urgent.

columns.name: DateFirstVisit
columns.summary: The date that the patient first visited the office.  Automated.

columns.name: ClinicNum
columns.summary: FK to clinic.ClinicNum. Can be zero if not attached to a clinic or no clinics set up.

columns.name: HasIns
columns.summary:
For now, an 'I' indicates that the patient has insurance.  This is only used when displaying appointments.  
            It will later be expanded.  User can't edit.

columns.name: TrophyFolder
columns.summary: The Trophy bridge is inadequate, this attempts to make it usable for offices that have invested in Trophy hardware.

columns.name: PlannedIsDone
columns.summary:
This simply indicates whether the 'done' box is checked in the chart module.  Used to be handled as a -1 in the NextAptNum field,
            but now that field is unsigned.

columns.name: Premed
columns.summary: Set to true if patient needs to be premedicated for appointments, includes PAC, halcion, etc.

columns.name: Ward
columns.summary: Only used in hospitals.

columns.name: PreferConfirmMethod
columns.summary: Enum:ContactMethod Used for eCR, which includes eReminders eConfirmations.

columns.name: PreferContactMethod
columns.summary: Enum:ContactMethod

columns.name: PreferRecallMethod
columns.summary: Enum:ContactMethod

columns.name: SchedDayOfWeek
columns.summary: We do not use this, but some users do, so here it is. 0=none. Otherwise, 1-7 for day.

columns.name: Language
columns.summary: The primary language of the patient.  Typically eng (English), fra (French), spa (Spanish), or similar.  If it's a custom language, then it might look like Tahitian. If none, then empty string.

columns.name: AdmitDate
columns.summary: Used in hospitals.  It can be before the first visit date.  It typically gets set automatically by the hospital system.

columns.name: Title
columns.summary:
Includes any punctuation.  For example, Mr., Mrs., Miss, Dr., etc.  
            There is no selection mechanism yet for user; they must simply type it in.

columns.name: PayPlanDue
columns.summary:
Amount "due now" for all payment plans such that someone in this family is the payment plan guarantor.  
            This is the total of all payment plan charges past due (taking into account the PayPlansBillInAdvanceDays setting) subtract the amount 
            already paid for the payment plans.  Only stored with family guarantor.

columns.name: SiteNum
columns.summary: FK to site.SiteNum. Can be zero. Replaces the old GradeSchool field with a proper foreign key.

columns.name: DateTStamp
columns.summary:
Automatically updated by MySQL every time a row is added or changed. Could be changed due to user editing, custom queries or 
            program updates.  Not user editable.

columns.name: ResponsParty
columns.summary:
FK to patient.PatNum. Can be zero.  Person responsible for medical decisions rather than finances.  Guarantor is still responsible
            for finances.  This is useful for nursing home residents.  Part of public health.

columns.name: CanadianEligibilityCode
columns.summary:
C09.  Eligibility Exception Code.  A number between 1-4.  0 is not acceptable for e-claims.
            1=FT student, 2=disabled, 3=disabled student, 4=code not applicable.  Warning.  4 is a 0 if using CDAnet version 02. 
            This column should have been created as an int.

columns.name: AskToArriveEarly
columns.summary: Number of minutes patient is asked to come early to appointments.

columns.name: PreferContactConfidential
columns.summary: Enum:ContactMethod  Used for EHR.

columns.name: SuperFamily
columns.summary:
FK to patient.PatNum.  If this is the same as PatNum, then this is a SuperHead.  If zero, then not part of a superfamily.  
            Synched for entire family.  If family is part of a superfamily, then the guarantor for this family will show in the superfamily list in the
            Family module for anyone else who is in the superfamily.  Only a guarantor can be a superfamily head.

columns.name: TxtMsgOk
columns.summary: Enum:YN

enumerations.name: YN
enumerations.summary: 0=Unknown,1=Yes, or 2=No. UI can be tricky. Some success with a 3x1 listbox, multicolumn, see FormPatientEdit. Radiobuttons are also an option.  You can also use another YN variable to store unknown, and then use a click event on the checkbox to change to Y or N.  You can also use a three state checkbox if you translate properly between the enums.

columns.name: SmokingSnoMed
columns.summary: EHR smoking status as a SNOMED code.  Will always be the most recent smoking status for the patient.

columns.name: Country
columns.summary: Country name.  Only used by HQ to add country names to statements.

columns.name: DateTimeDeceased
columns.summary:
Needed for EHR syndromic surveillance messaging.  Used in HL7 PID-29.  Also for feature request #3040.  Date and time because we 
            need precision to the minute in syndromic surveillence messging.

columns.name: BillingCycleDay
columns.summary:
A number between 1 and 31 that is the day of month that repeat charges should be applied to this account. 
            Previously this was determined by the start date of the repeate charges.

columns.name: SecUserNumEntry
columns.summary: FK to userod.UserNum.  Set to the user logged in when the row was inserted at SecDateEntry date and time.

columns.name: SecDateEntry
columns.summary: Date automatically generated and user not allowed to change.  Date when patient was inserted.

columns.name: HasSuperBilling
columns.summary: 0 by default.  If true, this guarantor should be included in superbilling statements.

columns.name: PatNumCloneFrom
columns.summary:
Deprecated, use patientlink table instead.
            Indicates if this patient should act as a clone of another patient. Previously, ortho cloned patients were signified by capitalizing the name fields of the newly cloned patient.
            This field will allow for an explicit flag to be set to indicate cloned status.

columns.name: DiscountPlanNum
columns.summary:
Deprecated, use discountplansub table instead.
            FK to discountplan.DiscountPlanNum. Will be 0 if there is no DiscountPlan.

columns.name: HasSignedTil
columns.summary: Signed Truth in Lending, relates to client permission to be charged interest on a payment plan.

columns.name: ShortCodeOptIn
columns.summary: Indicates if the patient has opted in, out, or not yet to using Short Codes for Appointment Texts.

columns.name: SecurityHash
columns.summary: Holds the salted hash of the PatNum. This prevents 3rd parties from inserting patients without our Db Integrity system noticing.

tables.name: patientnote
tables.summary: Essentially more columns in the patient table.  They are stored here because these fields can contain a lot of information, and we want to try to keep the size of the patient table a bit smaller.

columns.name: PatNum
columns.summary: FK to patient.PatNum.  Also the primary key for this table. Always one to one relationship with patient table.  A new patient might not have an entry here until needed.

columns.name: FamFinancial
columns.summary: Only one note per family stored with guarantor.

columns.name: ApptPhone
columns.summary: No longer used.

columns.name: Medical
columns.summary: Medical Summary

columns.name: Service
columns.summary: Service notes. Shows in Medical information window and in the Pt Info section of the Chart module.

columns.name: MedicalComp
columns.summary: Complete current Medical History

columns.name: Treatment
columns.summary: Shows in the Chart module normally just below the graphical tooth chart. Also known as Odontogram Notes.

columns.name: ICEName
columns.summary: In Case of Emergency Name.

columns.name: ICEPhone
columns.summary: In Case of Emergency Phone.

columns.name: OrthoMonthsTreatOverride
columns.summary:
-1 by default. Overrides the default number of months for an ortho treatment for this patient.
            Gets automatically set to the current value found in the pref OrthoDefaultMonthsTreat when the first placement procedure has been completed and this value is -1.
            This column is an integer instead of a byte because it needs to store -1 so that users can override with the value of 0.
            When set to -1 the default practice value for the pref OrthoDefaultMonthsTreat is used.

columns.name: DateOrthoPlacementOverride
columns.summary:
Overrides the date of the first ortho procedure for this patient to use for ortho case patients. 
            If MinDate, then the date is derived by looking at the first ortho procedure for this patient.

columns.name: SecDateTEntry
columns.summary: Timestamp automatically generated and user not allowed to change.  The actual date of entry.

columns.name: SecDateTEdit
columns.summary: Automatically updated by MySQL every time a row is added or changed.

columns.name: Consent
columns.summary:
Enum:PatConsentFlags None=0,ShareMedicationHistoryErx=1, Indicates if the patient consents for DoseSpot to access their medication
            history, bitwise.

values.name: None
values.value: 0 - None

values.name: ShareMedicationHistoryErx
values.value: 1 - Patient consents for eRx to access their medication history

columns.name: UserNumOrthoLocked
columns.summary: FK to userod.UserNum. A real-time flag of which user is currently editing the Orth Chart.  Prevents concurrency issues. 0 indicates unlocked. -5 indicates that an instance of OD changed users locally in order to sign an Ortho Chart row. -1 indicates another user with the same username took control.

columns.name: Pronoun
columns.summary: Enum: PronounPreferred Patient Pronoun override. None indicates no override.

tables.name: patplan
tables.summary: Each row represents the linking of one insplan to one patient for current coverage.  Dropping a plan will delete the entry in this table.  Deleting a patplan will delete the actual insplan (if no dependencies).

columns.name: PatPlanNum
columns.summary: Primary key

columns.name: PatNum
columns.summary: FK to  patient.PatNum.  The patient who currently has the insurance.  Not the same as the subscriber.

columns.name: Ordinal
columns.summary: Number like 1, 2, 3, etc.  Represents primary ins, secondary ins, tertiary ins, etc. 0 is not used

columns.name: IsPending
columns.summary: For informational purposes only. You have to enter the plan in order to check this box. Not related at all to the InsPending table.

columns.name: Relationship
columns.summary: Enum:Relat Remember that this may need to be changed in the Claim also, if already created.

enumerations.name: Relat
enumerations.summary: Relationship to subscriber for insurance.

columns.name: PatID
columns.summary: An optional patient ID which will override the insplan.SubscriberID on eclaims.  For Canada, this holds the Dependent Code, C17 and E17, and in that use it doesn't override subscriber id, but instead supplements it.

columns.name: InsSubNum
columns.summary: FK to inssub.InsSubNum.  Gives info about the subscriber.

columns.name: OrthoAutoFeeBilledOverride
columns.summary:
Only for Ortho practices. The fee that will be charged out by the auto procedureto insurance each period. 
            Overrides insplan.OrthoAutoFeeBilled. -1 to use insplan default. Instantiated to -1 in the program so that it defaults to the insplan default.

columns.name: OrthoAutoNextClaimDate
columns.summary:
Only for Ortho practices. The date before which the next automatic ortho procedure/claim cannot be automatically generated.
            If blank, this patient's ortho treatment has been stopped.

columns.name: SecDateTEntry
columns.summary: Timestamp automatically generated and user not allowed to change.  The actual date of entry.

columns.name: SecDateTEdit
columns.summary:
Automatically updated by MySQL every time a row is added or changed. Could be changed due to user editing, custom queries or program
            updates.  Not user editable with the UI.

tables.name: payment
tables.summary: A patient payment.  Always has at least one split.

columns.name: PayNum
columns.summary: Primary key.

columns.name: PayType
columns.summary: FK to definition.DefNum.  This will be 0 if this is an income transfer to another provider. Examples: Cash, Check, CC, Refund.

columns.name: PayDate
columns.summary: The date that the payment displays on the patient account.

columns.name: PayAmt
columns.summary: Amount of the payment.  Must equal the sum of the splits.

columns.name: CheckNum
columns.summary: Check number is optional.

columns.name: BankBranch
columns.summary: Bank-branch code for checks. Example 19-7076.

columns.name: PayNote
columns.summary: Any admin note.  Not for patient to see.  Length 4000.

columns.name: IsSplit
columns.summary: No longer used.  Set to true to indicate that a payment has more than one paysplit.

columns.name: PatNum
columns.summary: FK to patient.PatNum.  The patient where the payment entry will show.  But only the splits affect account balances.  This has a value even if the 'payment' is actually an income transfer to another provider.

columns.name: ClinicNum
columns.summary: FK to clinic.ClinicNum.  Can be 0 to indicate no clinic (unassigned). Copied from patient.ClinicNum when creating payment, but user can override.  Not used in provider income transfers.  Cannot be used in financial reporting when grouping by clinic, because payments may be split between clinics.

columns.name: DateEntry
columns.summary: The date that this payment was entered.  Not user editable.

columns.name: DepositNum
columns.summary: FK to deposit.DepositNum.  0 if not attached to any deposits.  Cash does not usually get attached to a deposit; only checks.

columns.name: Receipt
columns.summary: Text of printed receipt if the payment was done electronically. Allows reprinting if needed.

columns.name: IsRecurringCC
columns.summary: True if this was an automatically added recurring CC charge rather then one entered by the user.  This was set to true for all historical entries before version 11.1, but will be accurate after that.

columns.name: SecUserNumEntry
columns.summary: FK to userod.UserNum.  Set to the user logged in when the row was inserted at SecDateEntry date and time.

columns.name: SecDateTEdit
columns.summary:
Automatically updated by MySQL every time a row is added or changed. Could be changed due to user editing, custom queries or program

            A "Group Note" is a special kind of procedure. Its status is always EC. It always uses DCode "~GRP~". Just like all other procs, it can have exactly one ProcNote. To attach other procs to a Group Note, we use the ProcGroupItem table. It does not have to have any attachd procs, and their ProcStatuses do not matter (except maybe D). columns.name: SigIsTopaz
columns.summary: There are two kinds of signatures.  Topaz signatures use hardware manufactured by that company, and the signature is created by their library.  OD signatures work exactly the same way, but are only for on-screen signing.

columns.name: Signature
columns.summary: The encrypted signature.  A signature starts as a collection of vectors.  The Topaz .sig file format is proprietary.  The OD signature format looks like this: 45,68;48,70;49,72;0,0;55,88;etc. Tenths are allowed, so it's common to see decimals.  It's simply a sequence of points, separated by semicolons.  0,0 represents pen up.  Then, a hash is created from the Note, concatenated directly with the userNum.  For example, "This is a note3" gets turned into a hash of 2849283940385391 (16 bytes).  The hash is used to encrypt the signature data string using symmetric encryption.  Therefore, the actual signature cannot be retrieved from the database by ordinary means.  Also, the signature info cannot even be retrieved by Open Dental at all unless it supplies the same hash as before, proving that the data has not changed since signed.  If OD supplies the correct hash, then it will be able to extract the sequence of vectors which it will then use to display the signature.  The OD sigs are not compressed, and the Topaz sigs are.  But there is very little difference in their sizes.  It would be very rare for a signature to be larger than 1000 bytes. There are also situations where the API or web service inserts a totally different here. The first two points are int.MinVal. Example: -2147483648,-2147483648;-2147483648,-2147483648;47,23;12,35;... The remaining points after the first two are the byte values of individual letters that make up a string that will be displayed inside the signature box.

tables.name: recall
tables.summary:
A patient can only have one recall object per type.  
            The recall table stores a few dates that must be kept synchronized with other information in the database.  This is difficult.  
            Anytime one of the following items changes, things need to be synchronized: 
            procedurecode.SetRecall, any procedurelog change for a patient (procs added, deleted, completed, status changed, date changed, etc), patient status changed.  
            There are expected to be a few bugs in the synchronization logic, so anytime a patient's recall is opened, it will also update.
            
            During synchronization, the program will frequently alter DateDueCalc, DateDue, and DatePrevious based on trigger procs.  
            The system will also add and delete recalls as necessary. 
            But it will not delete a recall unless all values are default and there is no useful information.  
            When a user tries to delete a recall, they will only be successful if the trigger conditions do not apply.  
            Otherwise, they will have to disable the recall instead.

columns.name: RecallNum
columns.summary: Primary key.

columns.name: PatNum
columns.summary: FK to patient.PatNum.

columns.name: DateDueCalc
columns.summary:
Not editable.  The calculated date due. Generated by the program and subject to change anytime the conditions change. 
            It can be blank (0001-01-01) if no appropriate triggers.

columns.name: DateDue
columns.summary:
This is the date that is actually used when doing reports for recall. 
            It will usually be the same as DateDueCalc unless user has changed it. System will only update this field if it is the same as DateDueCalc.  
            Otherwise, it will be left alone.  Gets cleared along with DateDueCalc when resetting recall.  
            When setting disabled, this field will also be cleared.  This is the field to use if converting from another software.

columns.name: DatePrevious
columns.summary:
Not editable. Previous date that procedures were done to trigger this recall. It is calculated and enforced automatically.  
            If you want to affect this date, add a procedure to the chart with a status of C, EC, or EO.

columns.name: FKey
columns.summary:
A foreign key to a table associated with the PermType.  0 indicates not in use.  
            This is typically used for objects that have specific audit trails so that users can see all audit entries related to a particular object.  
            Every permission using FKey should be included and implmented in the CrudAuditPerms enum so that securitylog FKeys are note orphaned.
            Additonaly, the tabletype will to have the [CrudTable(CrudAuditPerms=CrudAuditPerm._____] added with the new CrudAuditPerm you created.
            For the patient portal, it is used to indicate logs created on behalf of other patients.  
            It's uses include:  AptNum with PermType AppointmentCreate, AppointmentEdit, or AppointmentMove tracks all appointment logs for a particular 
            appointment.
            CodeNum with PermType ProcFeeEdit currently only tracks fee changes.  
            PatNum with PermType PatientPortal represents an entry that a patient made on behalf of another patient.
            	The PatNum column will represent the patient who is taking the action.  
            PlanNum with PermType InsPlanChangeCarrierName tracks carrier name changes.

columns.name: FieldValue
columns.summary:
For OutputText, this value is set before printing.  This is the data obtained from the database and ready to print.  For StaticText, this is copied from the sheetFieldDef, but in-line fields like [this] will have been filled.  For an archived sheet retrieved from the database (all SheetField rows), this value will have been saved and will not be filled again automatically.For InputField, this is the filled value. If an an AutoNote attached, then this field will start out like AutoNoteNum:### until they click to fill out the autonote.Parameter fieldtype: this will store the value of the parameter. FKs are numbers. Two of the parameters allow multiple ProcNums, which are stored here as comma list.Drawing fieldtype: this will be the point data for the lines.  The format would look similar to this: 45,68;48,70;49,72;0,0;55,88;etc.  It's simply a sequence of points, separated by semicolons.CheckBox: it will either be an X or empty.SigBox: the first char will be 0 or 1 to indicate SigIsTopaz, and all subsequent chars will be the Signature itself.PatImage: FK to document.DocNum, or blank, or "MountNum:####" to indicate mount instead of document.ComboBox: The chosen option, semicolon, then a pipe delimited list of options such as: March;January|February|March|AprilScreenChart: Contains a semicolon delimited list of a single number followed by groups of comma separated surfaces.
            The first digit represents what type of ScreenChart it is.  0 = Permanent, 1 = Primary
            It may look like 0;S,P,N;S,S,S;... etc.Grid: Not used. All grid content is generated on the fly rather than preserved in the database. In the future, we should serialize grid content into here. But we probably have to overhaul the language translation for grids first.

values.name: None

columns.name: IsSigProvRestricted
columns.summary: When true, only allows the signature box to be signed by a provider. There is a completely separate Pref.NotesProviderSignatureOnly for doing the same thing in procedures etc., not sheets.

columns.name: UserSigned

In the richtextbox for drawing SigBoxes in FormSheetFillEdit.cs: "By: " will not show with the username if UserSigned value is 0. columns.name: FieldName
columns.summary:
FieldName is used differently for different FieldTypes. 
            For OutputText, each sheet typically has a main datatable type. For example statements correspond to the statment table. See SheetFieldsAvailable.GetList() for available values.     If the output field exactly matches a column from the main table this will be the <ColumnName>. For example, "FName" on patient Forms.     If the output field exactly matches a column from a different table this will be the <tablename>.<ColumnName>. For example, appt.Note on Routing Slips.     If the output field is not a database column it must start with a lowercase letter. For example, "statementReceiptInvoice" on Statements.For InputField, these are hardcoded to correspond to DB fields, for example "FName" corresponsds to patient.FName. See SheetFieldsAvailable.GetList() for available values.For Image, this file name with extention, for example "image1.jpg". Some image names are handled specially, for example "Patient Info.gif". Images are stored in <imagefolder>\SheetImages\image1.jpg.For CheckBox, this groups checkboxes together so that only one per group can be checked.For PatImage, this is the name of the DocCategory.For Special, identifies the type of special field. Currently only ToothChart and ToothChartLegend.For Grid, this is the specific type of grid. See SheetUtil.GetDataTableForGridType() for values. For example "StatementPayPlan". Column names use hard coded display fields that can be found in SheetUtil.GetGridColumnAvailable().For all other fieldtypes, FieldName is blank or irrelevant.

columns.name: FieldValue
columns.summary:
For StaticText, this text can include bracketed fields, like [nameLF].
            For OutputText and InputField, this will be blank.  If an InputField has an AutoNote attached, then this field will be AutoNoteNum:'value'. Example AutoNoteNum:268.For CheckBoxes, either X or blank.  Even if the checkbox is set to behave like a radio button.  For Pat Images, this is blank.  The filename of a PatImage will later be stored in SheetField.FieldValue.For ComboBoxes, the chosen option, semicolon, then a pipe delimited list of options such as: March;January|February|March|AprilFor ScreenCharts, a semicolon delimited list of comma separated surfaces.  It may look like S,P,N;S,S,S;... etc.For Grid, not used. All grid content is generated on the fly rather than preserved in the database. In the future, we should serialize grid content into here. But we probably have to overhaul the language translation for grids first.

Certain entries in this table can also trigger the Appointments module to refresh if that date is currently showing for any computer. To add a row here, use DataValid.SetInvalid. The result is that the primary tooth shows in addition to the perm, and that the letter shows in addition to the number.  It also does a Shift0 -12 and some other handy movements. enumerations.summary:
These FKey Types are to be used as an identifier for what table the Fkey column is associated to, or what type of override it is.
            Not always associated to a database table.  Example:  TaskCollapse,SuppressLogOffMessage,AcctProcBreakdown.
            Do not reorder items, since they are numbers in the db.

values.name: ImageCategoryExpanded
values.value: 0 - Imaging module expanded categories.  Presence of a row means expanded.  Absence means collapsed.  No valuestring needed. Can have FKey that relates to ImageCat defNum

values.name: ClinicLast
values.value: 1 - FKey to ClincNum Used to track the last opened clinic for the user.

values.name: WikiHomePage
values.value: 2 - Wiki home pages use ValueString to store the name of the wiki page instead of Fkey due to how FormWiki loads pages.

values.name: AutoNoteExpandedCats
values.value:
3 - ValueString will be a comma delimited list of DefNums for the last expanded categories for the user.  When FormAutoNotes loads,
            these categories will be expanded again.

values.name: TaskCollapse
values.value: 4 - Controls whether tasks will be collapsed or not by default

values.name: CommlogPersistClearNote
values.value: 5 - When FormCommItem is in Persistent mode, clear the note text box after the user creates a commlog.

values.name: CommlogPersistClearEndDate
values.value: 6 - When FormCommItem is in Persistent mode, clear the End text box after the user creates a commlog.

values.name: CommlogPersistUpdateDateTimeWithNewPatient
values.value: 7 - When FormCommItem is in Persistent mode, update the Date / Time text box with NOW() whenver the patient changes.

values.name: PerioCurrentExamOnly
values.value: 8 - Whether or not to display just the currently selected exam in the Perio Chart.

values.name: SmsGroupBy
values.value: 9 - Text message grouping preference. 0 - None; 1 - By Patient;

values.name: TaskListBlock
values.value: 10 - Stores a TaskListNum that the corresponding user wants to block all pop ups from.

values.name: Program
values.value: 11 - FKey to ProgramNum. Also used in DoseSpot for the DoseSpot User ID, stored in ValueString.

values.name: AcctProcBreakdown
values.value: 13 - Sets the default state of the Account Module "Show Proc Breakdowns" checkbox.

values.name: ProgramUserName
values.value: 14 - Stores user specific username for programs, generally used for Oryx.ProgNum.

values.name: ProgramPassword
values.value: 15 - Stores user specific password for programs.

values.name: Dashboard
values.value: 16 - Stores user specific dashboard to open on load. FKey points to the SheetDef.SheetDefNum that the user last had open.

values.name: UserTheme
values.value: 17 - Deprecated.

values.name: DynamicChartLayout
values.value: 18 - Stores the Dynamic Chart Layout SheetDef.SheetDefNum selected by a user, FKey points to ShetDef.SheetDefNum.

values.name: PerioAutoAdvanceFacialsFirst
values.value: 19 - Whether or not to set the perio auto advance to custom.

values.name: LogOffTimerOverride
values.value: 20 - Stores the value (in minutes) of when the user should be auto logged off.

values.name: ReceivedSupplyOrders
values.value: 21 - Whether or not we check the "Show received" checkbox when loading the supply order history.

values.name: ToothChartUsesDiffColorByProv
values.value: 22 - Color defs can be used for different proc statuses when the user's provider doesn't match the procedure's provider.

values.name: ShowAutomatedCommlog
values.value: 23 - Whether to show automated commlogs in the account module, chart module, and appointment edit window.

values.name: QueryMonitorHasStackTraces
values.value: 24 - Preference that indicates whether stack traces are to be logged by the query monitor or not. If exists 0 or 1 is stored in ValueString

values.name: WikiSearchIncludeContent
values.value: 25 - Preference only applies to the wiki search. Set and unset only in the wiki search window. Box defaults to checked if this preference is not set.

values.name: TaskBlockedMakeSound
values.value: 26 - Sets whether tasks popups that are blocked still play the sound notification. If true, sound will play. If false, sound will be blocked as well.

values.name: ImageSelectorWidth
values.value: 27 - Stores the width of the left Image Selector (tree) of the Imaging module in the ValueString. Does not store expanded/collapsed, so this width would be the expanded width. There is no limit. Does not use FKey.

columns.name: ValueString
columns.summary: Used to hold the override, which might be a simple primitive value, a comma separated list, or a complex document in xml.

columns.name: ClinicNum
columns.summary: FK to Clinic.ClinicNum, The default clinic for a User. This is duplicate info that's already available in userod.ClinicNum, but having it here might allow simpler queries or linq.

tables.name: userquery
tables.summary: A list of query favorites that users can run.

columns.name: QueryNum
columns.summary: Primary key.

columns.name: Description
columns.summary: Description.

columns.name: FileName
columns.summary: The name of the file to export to.

columns.name: QueryText
columns.summary: The text of the query.

columns.name: IsReleased
columns.summary: Determines whether the query is safe for users with lower permissions.  Also causes this user query to be available in the Main Menu, Reports, Query Favorites Filtered.

columns.name: IsPromptSetup
columns.summary: Determines whether the Query Favorites window should prompt for query values via FormQueryParser/'SET Fields' popup when running query.

columns.name: DefaultFormatRaw
columns.summary: Determines whether the UserQuery window loads with the 'Raw' format radio button pre-selected. For a new userquery, this is set based on pref.UserQueryDefaultRaw.

tables.name: wikipage
tables.summary: Rows never edited, just added, unless the wiki page is a draft.  Contains only newest versions of each page and all drafts.

columns.name: WikiPageNum
columns.summary: Primary key.

columns.name: UserNum
columns.summary: FK to userod.UserNum.

columns.name: PageTitle
columns.summary: Must be unique.  Any character is allowed except: \r, \n, and ".  Needs to be tested, especially with apostrophes.

columns.name: KeyWords
columns.summary: Automatically filled from the [[Keywords:]] tab in the PageContent field as page is being saved.

columns.name: PageContent
columns.summary: Content of page stored in "wiki markup language".  This should never be updated, unless it is a draft.  Medtext (16M)

columns.name: DateTimeSaved
columns.summary: The DateTime that the page was saved to the DB.  User can't directly edit.

columns.name: IsDraft
columns.summary: Signifies that the wiki page is a draft, and will only show in the Wiki Drafts form.

columns.name: IsLocked
columns.summary: Records if a wiki page is locked.  If it is locked, only user swith the WikiAdmin permission are allowed to edit the page

columns.name: IsDeleted
columns.summary: This flag will be set when the user archives the WikiPage.

columns.name: PageContentPlainText
columns.summary: Content of page stored without any HTML markup or wiki page links.  This plain text allows for easier searching.

tables.name: zipcode
tables.summary: Zipcodes are also known as postal codes.  Zipcodes are always copied to patient records rather than linked.  So items in this list can be freely altered or deleted without harming patient data.

columns.name: ZipCodeNum
columns.summary: Primary key.

columns.name: ZipCodeDigits
columns.summary: The actual zipcode.

columns.name: IsFrequent
columns.summary: If true, then it will show in the dropdown list in the patient edit window.
